name: CodeRabbit Triage
desc: Queue that ranks open pull requests by value and risk across repositories.
desc_zh: 跨仓库按价值和风险给待审 Pull Request 排序的队列。
solves: With agent-generated pull requests arriving faster than reviewers, the order you pick them in decides what ships; the queue re-sorts itself.
solves_zh: 智能体生成的 Pull Request 比审查者来得快，先审哪个决定了能合什么；这个队列会自己重新排序。
best_for: Forty pull requests are open and you have one afternoon of review time.
best_for_zh: 开着四十个 Pull Request，而你只有一个下午的审查时间。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — docs.coderabbit.ai/changelog directory）。 Free for open-source organisations across GitLab, GitHub Enterprise Server, Azure DevOps and Bitbucket from 2026-11-13. 首次公开日期来源：https://docs.coderabbit.ai/changelog
